summary: The note describes Hilkot, a village and union council (an administrative subdivision) in Mansehra District of Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. It gives its location relative to Mansehra city and Batagram city, and notes that the area was affected by the 2005 Kashmir earthquake.
one_line: Hilkot is a village and union council in Mansehra District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, located in an area hit by the 2005 Kashmir earthquake.
key_facts: Hilkot is a village and union council (an administrative subdivision) of Mansehra District.
Hilkot is located in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province of Pakistan.
Hilkot is located to the north of Mansehra, the district capital.
Hilkot is located south west of Batagram city.
Hilkot lies in an area affected by the 2005 Kashmir earthquake.
